events.title: Watch Duty deploys Gemini across wildfire radio monitoring
events.title_zh: Watch Duty 将 Gemini 用于野火无线电监听
events.summary: Google and Watch Duty described a deployed transcription pipeline for roughly 400 active VHF wildfire radio feeds and more than 200 audio hours per day. The partners report word error rate falling from 38% to 22.34% on degraded audio and volunteer satisfaction rising from 35.3% to 92.3%. Humans still verify critical alerts before publication.
events.summary_en: Google and Watch Duty described a deployed transcription pipeline for roughly 400 active VHF wildfire radio feeds and more than 200 audio hours per day. The partners report word error rate falling from 38% to 22.34% on degraded audio and volunteer satisfaction rising from 35.3% to 92.3%. Humans still verify critical alerts before publication.
events.summary_zh: Google 与 Watch Duty 公开了一条已部署的转录流水线，用于约 400 路活跃 VHF 野火无线电和每天 200 多小时音频。双方称嘈杂音频的词错误率从 38% 降至 22.34%，志愿者满意度从 35.3% 升至 92.3%。关键警报发布前仍由人核验。
events.why_it_matters: This is a concrete high-noise, high-stakes deployment rather than a generic speech benchmark. It supports using models for triage while keeping humans responsible for consequential alerts; results come from a Google partner case study and lack independent evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_en: This is a concrete high-noise, high-stakes deployment rather than a generic speech benchmark. It supports using models for triage while keeping humans responsible for consequential alerts; results come from a Google partner case study and lack independent evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是普通语音 benchmark，而是高噪声、高风险的真实部署。它支持“模型先分流、人再确认”的做法；数字来自 Google 与合作方案例，尚无独立评测。

technical_details.deployment: About 400 active VHF feeds and more than 200 audio hours per day; designed and tested for more than 10,000 feeds
technical_details.partner_reported_quality: Word error rate 38% to 22.34% on degraded audio; volunteer satisfaction 35.3% to 92.3%
technical_details.incident_example: Railroad Fire dispatch flagged in under 30 seconds in July; humans verified before a critical alert
technical_details.human_role: Critical information is reviewed before publication
technical_details.evidence_limit: Google and partner case study; test set, baseline construction and independent reproduction are not public
technical_details.time_basis: Official post timestamped 2026-11-20T17:00:00Z, seven minutes before this run started

technical_details_zh.部署: 约 400 路活跃 VHF 信号、每天 200 多小时音频；系统按 10,000 路以上规模设计并测试
technical_details_zh.合作方报告质量: 嘈杂音频词错误率从 38% 降至 22.34%；志愿者满意度从 35.3% 升至 92.3%
technical_details_zh.事件案例: 7 月 Railroad Fire 调度在 30 秒内被标记；关键警报发布前由人核验
technical_details_zh.人工职责: 关键信息发布前必须审核
technical_details_zh.证据限制: Google 与合作方案例；测试集、基线构造和独立复现未公开
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方文章时间为 2026-11-20T17:00:00Z，比本轮开始早 7 分钟

events.next_action_zh: 等待公开测试集或独立应急场景复现，再把类似流水线用于会触发告警的生产系统。
events.next_action_en: Wait for a public test set or independent emergency-response reproduction before using the pattern in production alerting.

evidence.claim_zh: Google 与 Watch Duty 的案例确认部署规模、发布方指标与人工核验边界。
evidence.claim_en: The Google and Watch Duty case confirms deployment scale, partner-reported metrics and the human review boundary.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; partner metrics not independently reproduced

changes.summary_zh: Watch Duty 公开 Gemini 野火无线电转录的生产数据
changes.summary_en: Watch Duty publishes production data for Gemini wildfire-radio transcription
